defense_news.title: Guard appears to rebuke Hegseth’s delegation at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army sentinel moved toward the group and, from a distance, shouted toward them: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times."

defense_news.title: Inside Warhound’s plan to engineer a better military working dog
defense_news.summary: The company plans to clone top-performing dogs, edit genes associated with health problems and introduce standardized training to puppies as young as two weeks old.

defense_news.title: House Republicans sidestep effort to impeach Hegseth
defense_news.summary: In a 211 to 204 vote, House Republicans sent proposed impeachment articles against Hegseth to the Judiciary Committee, quashing the effort.
